ext.description: Delegates tasks to Copilot CLI via SDK — creates isolated sessions, monitors progress, and orchestrates merges automatically
tool.delegate_task.userDescription: Delegates a task to the Copilot CLI in an isolated session
tool.delegate_task.modelDescription: Creates a new CLI session and delegates a task to Copilot. Optionally creates an isolated worktree and injects custom agents/skills.
tool.check_session.userDescription: Checks the state of a delegated session
tool.check_session.modelDescription: Checks the current state of a delegated session: status, plan, modified files.
tool.send_message.userDescription: Sends a message to an active session
tool.send_message.modelDescription: Sends an additional message to an active session (follow-up, correction, instruction).
tool.list_sessions.modelDescription: Lists all delegation sessions managed by the extension.
tool.cleanup_session.userDescription: Terminates a session and cleans up resources
tool.cleanup_session.modelDescription: Terminates a session and cleans up resources (disconnect, remove worktree, clean registry).
tool.wait_for_session.userDescription: Waits for a delegated session to finish and returns the result
tool.wait_for_session.modelDescription: ⚠️ DO NOT USE FOR ORCHESTRATION (fire-and-forget). When the orchestrator delegates with cooperationMode=true (default in autopilot mode), the session-end callback fires automatically and re-engages the chat with the full result — calling this tool blocks the orchestrator turn while the callback is ALREADY on its way, locking the UI on 'Aguardando sessão…' even after the session reached idle/completed. USE ONLY when (a) running in a non-autopilot script/test where no callback is registered, OR (b) explicitly need a synchronous result inside one tool call. For all orchestration flows, do NOT call this — delegate, end the turn, let the callback bring you back. Returns status, last message, summary, changed files and metrics.
tool.get_session_history.userDescription: Queries the event history of a session
tool.get_session_history.modelDescriptio: Returns the event history of a delegated session. Allows filtering by type (messages, tools, errors, etc.).
tool.switch_model.userDescription: Switches the model of an active session
tool.switch_model.modelDescription: Switches the AI model of an active session. Can optionally set the reasoning level.
tool.set_session_mode.userDescription: Toggles the mode of a session (plan/autopilot/interactive)
tool.set_session_mode.modelDescription: Toggles the operational mode of an active session between plan (plan only), autopilot (executes automatically), and interactive.
tool.update_plan.userDescription: Injects or updates the plan of a session
tool.update_plan.modelDescription: Injects or updates the plan (markdown) of an active session. Useful for orchestrators that want to guide the session.
tool.read_session_file.userDescription: Reads or lists files from a session workspace
tool.read_session_file.modelDescription: Reads the content of a file in the session workspace, or lists files if path is not provided.
tool.resume_session.modelDescription: Reconnects to a session that was disconnected, restoring the previous state.
tool.compact_session.userDescription: Compacts the context of a long session
tool.compact_session.modelDescription: Compacts the context of a session, freeing space to continue long conversations.
tool.select_agent.userDescription: Selects a custom agent within the session
tool.select_agent.modelDescription: Selects or deselects a custom agent within an active session. If agentName is omitted, deselects the current agent.
tool.session_log.userDescription: Injects logs/breadcrumbs into the session timeline
tool.session_log.modelDescription: Injects a log message into the timeline of an active session. Useful for breadcrumbing and debugging.
tool.delegate_pipeline.userDescription: Chains multiple sessions into a sequential pipeline
tool.delegate_pipeline.modelDescription: Creates a pipeline that chains multiple sessions: output from step N is injected as context into the prompt of step N+1.
tool.discover_project.userDescription: Autonomously analyzes the project and generates complete context documentation
tool.discover_project.modelDescription: Launches an autonomous discovery pipeline: scans structure, analyzes codebase, examines git history, creates complete project documentation.
tool.check_pipeline.userDescription: Checks the state of a pipeline
tool.check_pipeline.modelDescription: Checks the current state of a pipeline: status, current step, results per step.
tool.wait_for_pipeline.userDescription: Waits for a pipeline to finish and returns the result
tool.wait_for_pipeline.modelDescription: Waits for a pipeline to finish (completed/failed/partial). Blocks until the result is ready or timeout.
tool.merge_session.userDescription: Merges worktree changes back to the main repo
tool.merge_session.modelDescription: Merges changes from a worktree back to the main repo via git merge. Commits pending changes before merging.
tool.resolve_conflicts.userDescription: Resolves merge conflicts in a session
tool.resolve_conflicts.modelDescription: Resolves merge conflicts in a session worktree. Supports automatic strategies (lockfiles/generated files use ours) and delegated resolution.
tool.resolve_integration_conflict.userDe: Inspect or resolve 3-way merge conflicts on an integration branch
tool.resolve_integration_conflict.modelD: Inspect 3-way merge state (base/HEAD/MERGE_HEAD) for conflict files on an integration branch, or commit a resolution after files have been edited. Used by the chat LLM to resolve parallel delegation conflicts automatically. Action 'inspect' returns conflict file contents with base/ours/theirs versions. Action 'commit-resolution' stages all files and commits with the default merge message.
tool.pause_session.userDescription: Pauses an active session by sending a pause message
tool.pause_session.modelDescription: Sends a pause message to an active session (running/started). The session receives instructions to pause and commit current work.
tool.stop_session.modelDescription: Stops a running session. By default sends a graceful message asking to commit work in progress before stopping.
tool.clone_session.userDescription: Clones an existing session to experiment with different approaches
tool.clone_session.modelDescription: Clones an existing session with the same context to experiment with different approaches. Creates a new worktree with the same state.
tool.delegate_pipeline_template.userDesc: Starts a pipeline from a pre-defined template (research-first, quick-fix, security-audit, refactor, etc.)
tool.delegate_pipeline_template.modelDes: Expands a named template into a complete pipeline with pre-configured steps. Available templates: research-first (3 steps: research → implement → validate), quick-fix (2 steps: fix → validate), test-coverage (2 steps: implement tests → validate), refactor (3 steps: analyze → refactor → validate), discovery-then-implement (3 steps: research → implement → validate), security-audit (2 steps: researcher audits OWASP/CVE/deps/secrets → validator prioritizes findings — read-only, no code changes), validation-only (1 step: compile+lint+test), implement-only (2 steps: implement → validate), tech-doc (4 steps: research → write docs → review → validate), tool-discovery (2 steps: scan project → generate shells).
tool.classify_delegation.userDescription: Classifies the request and suggests the best delegation pattern
tool.classify_delegation.modelDescriptio: Classifies the user request and suggests which delegation pattern to use (pipeline template, fire-and-forget, etc.).
tool.query_lessons.userDescription: Queries learned lessons from previous delegations for the current project
tool.query_lessons.modelDescription: Queries per-project lessons from Session Learning v2. When 'query' is provided, lessons are ranked by semantic relevance (keyword overlap, task type match, recency) instead of simple text search. Use before implementing to retrieve relevant patterns, pitfalls, conventions. Returns structured lessons with id, category, context, and tags. After applying a lesson, call acknowledge_lesson to mark it as useful.
tool.acknowledge_lesson.userDescription: Marks lessons as useful — only acknowledged lessons count toward skill promotion
tool.acknowledge_lesson.modelDescription: Marks one or more lessons as actively useful for the current task. Call this after query_lessons when a lesson guided your implementation. Only acknowledged lessons increment their promotion score — lessons that are merely queried but not acknowledged do not count. Accepts project name and array of lesson IDs.

setting.sdkPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `copilot-sdk/index.js`. When set, skips automatic discovery and uses this path directly.
setting.autoCleanupSessions.markdownDesc: When enabled, sessions are automatically cleaned up after successful auto-merge, pipeline completion, or reaching settled status.
setting.shellBudgetPerTurn.markdownDescr: Maximum number of shell tool invocations allowed per chat turn. Mirrors the VS Code 1.118 "agentic execution tool" cap of 10. When exhausted, additional calls return a budget message instead of executing.
setting.completedSessionTTL.markdownDesc: Time in ms for auto-cleanup of completed sessions that were not cleaned by auto-merge (0 = disabled).
setting.settleTimeoutMs.markdownDescript: Time in ms to consider an idle session as completed.
setting.postReportGraceMs.markdownDescri: Grace period in ms after REPORT detection before auto-stopping a session that keeps running. Prevents sessions from wasting tokens on pointless operations after completing their task.
setting.maxEventLogSize.markdownDescript: Maximum size of the event buffer per session.
setting.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Default model for new delegated sessions.
setting.copilotDelegate_autoRetry.markdo: 🦑 When enabled, sessions that fail are automatically re-dispatched with the same prompt (Regen).
setting.copilotDelegate_maxRetries.markd: 🦑 Maximum number of auto-retry attempts per session.
setting.copilotDelegate_callback_mode.ma: 🐙 Controls how delegate session results are delivered to the chat. `queue` (default) buffers results and shows a notification — your draft is never overwritten. `immediate` injects directly into the chat input (legacy behavior).
setting.copilotDelegate_callback_mode.qu: Buffer results and notify — never overwrite the chat draft (recommended)
setting.copilotDelegate_callback_mode.im: Inject directly into chat input (may overwrite user draft)
setting.androidBridge_enabled.markdownDe: 📱 Enables Android Bridge — HTTP/WebSocket server for connectivity with Android apps via LAN.
setting.androidBridge_port.markdownDescr: 📱 Android Bridge port (`0` = dynamic port allocated by OS, recommended).
setting.androidBridge_host.markdownDescr: 📱 Host binding — `0.0.0.0` (all interfaces, for Android via WiFi/LAN) or `127.0.0.1` (localhost only).
setting.copilotDelegate_session_retentio: 🐙 Number of recent sessions to keep when running Cleanup All. 0 = clean everything.
setting.copilotDelegate_daemon_enabled.m: 🔧 Enables automatic daemon lifecycle management (installation, update, initialization).
setting.copilotDelegate_daemon_autoUpdat: 🔧 Automatically updates the daemon to the latest version from GitHub.
setting.copilotDelegate_daemon_githubRep: 🔧 GitHub repository for daemon releases (format: owner/repo).
setting.copilotDelegate_daemon_healthChe: 🔧 Interval in ms between daemon health checks (default: 60000).
setting.copilotDelegate_daemon_startTime: 🔧 Timeout in ms to wait for the daemon to start (default: 5000).
setting.copilotDelegate_reactive_enabled: ⚡ Enable reactive mid-flight control: auto-escalate model when session encounters consecutive tool errors
setting.copilotDelegate_reactive_errorTh: ⚡ Number of consecutive tool errors before triggering escalation (default: 3)
setting.copilotDelegate_reactive_escalat: ⚡ Model to escalate to when error threshold is reached (default: claude-opus-4.6)
setting.copilotDelegate_worktree_sharedD: 📂 Directories to share via junction/symlink between workspace and delegate worktrees. Files written by one session become immediately visible to others.
setting.copilotDelegate_worktree_shareAl: 🔗 **Recommended: ON.** When `true` (default), every gitignored directory (except `node_modules`) is mounted as a junction/symlink into delegated worktrees, so files the session writes — task maps, plans, research notes, any `docs/` artifact — land directly in your workspace and survive worktree cleanup. **⚠️ Turning this OFF will silently lose any file the delegated session writes outside of git-tracked paths**, including content the session reports as 'saved'. Only disable if you understand worktree isolation semantics.
setting.copilotDelegate_worktree_skipDir: 🚫 Directory names that are NEVER linked into a delegated worktree (neither junction nor hardlink). Defaults cover heavy build outputs and tooling caches: `node_modules`, `target` (Java/Rust), `build`, `dist`, `out`, `bin`, `obj` (.NET), `.next`, `.nuxt`, `.svelte-kit`, `.turbo`, `.cache`, `.gradle`, `.mvn`, `__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `.venv`, `venv`, `coverage`. Add your project's build output here (e.g. `target` for Maven, `dist` for bundlers) if it isn't already covered. `node_modules` is always skipped regardless of this list.
setting.copilotDelegate_session_maxUnres: 💓 Minutes an unresponsive session is tolerated before being auto-stopped (default: 10)
🔀 Enables auto-merge in Autonomous mode after session completes.
setting.copilotDelegate_merge_rescueTent: 🔀 Spawns rescue tentacle when auto-merge fails.
setting.copilotDelegate_health_heartbeat: 💓 Interval in ms between health monitor heartbeats (default: 30000).
setting.copilotDelegate_health_probeEnab: 💓 Enables active probe on unresponsive sessions.
setting.copilotDelegate_cleanup_sessionT: 🧹 Hours to expire idle sessions (0 = never).
setting.copilotDelegate_pipeline_retenti: 🧹 Hours to retain completed/failed pipelines before automatic removal (default: 24).
setting.copilotDelegate_pipeline_handoff: 📋 Maximum characters for raw output in pipeline step handoff context (default: 16000). Increase if researcher plans are being truncated.
setting.copilotDelegate_ledger_enabled.m: 📒 Enable automatic task ledger for completed delegations.
setting.copilotDelegate_learning_autoInj: 🧠 Controls lesson injection in delegations. `off`: no lessons. `on`: Octopus must query lessons before delegating (enforced by hook). `auto`: same as `on` when lessons exist for the project.
setting.copilotDelegate_learning_injectM: 🧠 Controls how lessons are delivered to delegated sessions. `reference` (default): instructs the CLI agent to query lessons itself via `query_lessons` tool — saves prompt tokens. `inline`: pastes full lesson text into the prompt (legacy behavior).
setting.copilotDelegate_learning_skillPr: ✨ Controls lesson-to-skill promotion. `off`: disabled. `notify`: shows notification when a lesson reaches threshold — you accept or reject. `auto`: automatically delegates a CLI session to create a skill from high-scoring lessons.
setting.copilotDelegate_learning_promoti: ✨ Promotion score threshold. A lesson's score increments each time it appears in top-ranked results. When it reaches this threshold, skill promotion is triggered (default: 5).
setting.copilotDelegate_tests_runByDefau: 🐙 If true, every delegation includes test instructions. If false (default), tests only run when explicitly requested via runTests: true.
setting.copilotDelegate_activeProfile.ma: 🐙 Active Agent Profile. Each profile controls model, mode, retry, cleanup, isolation, and agent personality. Workspace setting overrides global.
setting.copilotDelegate_parallelBudget.m: 🐙 Budget for cost-based parallelism calculation. Higher = more parallel delegations with cheaper models. Formula: `maxParallel = floor(budget / billing.multiplier)`.
setting.copilotDelegate_maxParallelDeleg: 🐙 Absolute cap on parallel delegations — 8 tentacles like a real octopus 🐙.
profile.observe.description: Research and analysis only — never implements
profile.alert.description: Premium model, deep analysis, aggressive retry
tool.delegate_test.userDescription: Executes validation gates (lint, compile, test) without implementation
tool.delegate_test.modelDescription: Executes validation gates without implementation. Supports pre-package (lint+compile+unit), pre-push (+integration), pre-release (+e2e+coverage), and on-demand (custom scope) gates. Returns pass/fail per step.
tool.retry_session.userDescription: Retries a session with adjustments (model, mode, prompt)
tool.retry_session.modelDescription: Retries a completed or failed session with optional adjustments: different model, mode, or additional instructions. Preserves lessons from the previous attempt by default.
tool.retry_pipeline_step.userDescription: Retries a specific step of a pipeline
tool.retry_pipeline_step.modelDescriptio: Retries a single step of an existing pipeline without re-executing other steps. Supports model override and prompt replacement.
tool.retry_pipeline_from_step.userDescri: Retries a pipeline from a specific step, preserving earlier results
tool.retry_pipeline_from_step.modelDescr: Retries a pipeline from a specific step onward, keeping results of earlier completed steps. Supports model override for retried steps.
tool.create_task_map.userDescription: Creates a task analysis map file in docs/maps/
tool.create_task_map.modelDescription: Creates a task analysis map file at docs/maps/<alias>.md in the project directory. Used for persisting intent, decisions, and context that survives context compression. Reads the template, fills with session context, and writes the file. Also clears the enforcement marker.
setting.copilotDelegate_tests_gates.mark: 🧪 Test gate configuration: defines which validation steps run for each gate level (pre-package, pre-push, pre-release).
setting.copilotDelegate_fastPath_enabled: ⚡ Enables fast paths for lightweight tasks. When enabled, plan-only and research tasks skip worktree creation, light tasks run lint-only, and docs-only changes skip all validation.
setting.copilotDelegate_fastPath_docExte: ⚡ File extensions considered as documentation for docs-only fast path.
setting.copilotDelegate_fastPath_docPath: ⚡ Directory paths considered as documentation for docs-only fast path.
setting.copilotDelegate_deduplication_en: 🔒 Enables session deduplication — detects and warns when similar prompts are submitted within a time window.
setting.copilotDelegate_deduplication_ti: 🔒 Time window in ms for deduplication detection (default: 30000).
setting.copilotDelegate_deduplication_st: 🔒 Strategy when duplicate is detected: `warn` (proceed with warning), `block` (reject), `reuse` (return existing session).
setting.copilotDelegate_parallelism_maxC: 🔄 Maximum total concurrent sessions across all weights (default: 5).
setting.copilotDelegate_parallelism_maxB: 🔄 Maximum concurrent sessions per task weight. Keys: ultralight, light, standard, heavy, gate-only.
setting.copilotDelegate_parallelism_queu: 🔄 Queue strategy when parallelism limit is reached: `priority` (lighter tasks first) or `fifo` (first-in-first-out).
setting.copilotDelegate_reactive_switchV: ⚡ Controls validation of model/mode switches during execution. `strict`: blocks switch during running sessions. `warn`: allows with warning. `off`: no validation.
setting.copilotDelegate_confirmBeforeDel: When enabled, the Octopus agent explains its understanding of the task and delegation plan before proceeding. Disable for direct delegation without confirmation.
When enabled, delegation callbacks inject an instruction for the LLM to generate a Task Map file at `docs/maps/`. The map includes intent, key decisions, files changed, lessons learned, and context for follow-up tasks.
setting.copilotDelegate_taskMap_director: Where Task Map files are stored and indexed. **Empty (default)**: each workspace folder uses its own `docs/maps/` (per-repo). **Relative path** (e.g. `notes/maps`): applied to each workspace folder. **Absolute path** (e.g. `D:/shared/maps`): single shared directory across all folders. The Brain indexes whichever locations are in effect.

tool.party_start.userDescription: Starts a DSTP (Don't Stop the Party) session
tool.party_start.modelDescription: Creates a new DSTP party template in intake mode. Analyzes the request for vague terms (Gate 1). Returns party_id and anti-vagueness results. After creating, fill mandatory fields, set acceptance criteria, run reality check, and finalize with user confirmation before execution begins.
tool.party_draft_template.userDescriptio: Shows the current party template with field status
tool.party_draft_template.modelDescripti: Returns the current DSTP party template with all fields, fill status, acceptance criteria, delegation plan, and completion percentage.
tool.party_update_field.userDescription: Updates a field in the party template (intake; limited fields in execution)
tool.party_update_field.modelDescription: Updates a specific field in the party template. During intake: all fields allowed. During execution: only acceptance_criteria and destructive_actions. Valid fields: goal, scope, success_metric, rollback_plan, interpretation_chosen, viability, plan_evolvable, destructive_actions, acceptance_criteria.
tool.party_reality_check.userDescription: Runs the reality check gate on the party template
tool.party_reality_check.modelDescriptio: Gate 3: Analyzes the party template for scope, risks, destructive actions, and viability (high/medium/low). If viability is low, returns reduction suggestions. Returns falsePositiveCandidates when destructive actions match release patterns (push/tag/publish).
tool.party_override_viability.userDescri: Overrides viability assessment with LLM justification
tool.party_override_viability.modelDescr: LLM-driven override of viability when reality_check returns false positives (e.g., release tasks flagged for git push/tag). Requires justification ≥20 chars citing actual user context. Only allowed during intake. Use when falsePositiveCandidates suggest the destructive actions are legitimate for the task.
tool.party_finalize.userDescription: Finalizes intake and starts execution (requires user confirmation)
tool.party_finalize.modelDescription: Transitions the party from intake to execution mode. REQUIRES literal user confirmation string — LLM cannot auto-confirm. Validates all 3 gates (anti-vagueness, zero-ambiguity, reality-check) pass before allowing transition.
tool.party_check.modelDescription: Returns checklist status with completion percentage. When 100% complete in execution state, automatically transitions to done. Use after each milestone during execution.
tool.party_stuck.userDescription: Declares the LLM is stuck and gets cascade hints
tool.party_stuck.modelDescription: Logs a stuck entry and returns cascade hints ordered by priority: task map, docs/, codebase grep, fetch_webpage, test patterns. Continue trying hints in order — do NOT give up.
tool.party_abort.modelDescription: Immediately transitions the party to aborted state. REQUIRES userRequested:true — only call this when the user explicitly says 'abort'/'stop'/'cancel'. During execution state, calling with userRequested:false is rejected. If YOU are stuck, call party_stuck instead. Never auto-abort.
tool.party_status.modelDescription: Read-only status view. With partyId: returns state, completion, criteria, stuck log. Without partyId: lists all active parties.
tool.party_plan_add.userDescription: Adds a delegation to the pre-approved plan
tool.party_plan_add.modelDescription: Appends a new entry to the delegation plan. Only works when plan_evolvable=true (approved by user during reality check) and state=execution. Append-only, logged.
tool.party_complete_criterion.userDescri: Marks an acceptance criterion as complete
tool.party_complete_criterion.modelDescr: Marks a single acceptance criterion as complete with optional proof. When all criteria are complete and state is execution, auto-transitions to done. Use after verifying each acceptance criterion during execution.

setting.brain_enabled.markdownDescriptio: Enable the Brain knowledge retrieval pipeline. When `false`, the `brain-gate` hook exits immediately with zero overhead.
setting.brain_mode.markdownDescription: Brain operating mode: `off` (disabled), `observe` (dry-run logging), `enforce` (active context injection).
setting.brain_gatePort.markdownDescripti: TCP port for the Brain gate HTTP server on `127.0.0.1`. Set to `0` (default) for OS-assigned port.
setting.brain_retriever_bm25Weight.markd: Weight for FTS lexical score in Brain hybrid ranking (0.0–1.0). Higher values favor keyword matches.
setting.brain_retriever_vectorWeight.mar: Weight for vector cosine score in Brain hybrid ranking (0.0–1.0). Higher values favor semantic similarity.
setting.brain_retriever_defaultK.markdow: Default number of knowledge chunks to retrieve per query.
setting.brain_retriever_mmrLambda.markdo: MMR diversity parameter (0.0 = maximum diversity, 1.0 = maximum relevance). Controls the balance between relevance and novelty in retrieved results.
setting.brain_judge_preferredBackend.mar: Judge backend preference: `cascade` tries Ollama first then Copilot SDK, `ollama` uses only local Ollama, `sdk` uses only Copilot SDK.
setting.brain_judge_ollamaModel.markdown: Ollama model used for the Brain judge. Must be pre-pulled. Recommended: `llama3.2:1b` or `qwen2.5:1.5b`.
setting.brain_judge_ollamaHost.markdownD: Ollama HTTP endpoint for the Brain judge.
setting.brain_judge_sdkModelFamily.markd: Copilot SDK model family used for the Brain judge. Must be available in your Copilot plan.
setting.brain_judge_timeoutMs.markdownDe: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a judge response from either backend.
setting.brain_failureLog_enabled.markdow: Enable or disable the Brain failure log. When enabled, user corrections boost matching knowledge chunks for future retrieval.

tool.multi_dev_spawn.userDescription: Spawns a team of dev chat tabs sequentially and waits until each registers (or per-dev timeout)
tool.multi_dev_spawn.modelDescription: Spawns one or more dev chat editor tabs SEQUENTIALLY and BLOCKS until every dev self-registers via multi_dev_register, or per-dev timeout (30s each) elapses. Pass `devs: [{label, agent?, tier?, model?, feature?, instructions?, split?}]`. Returns `{team: [{label, registered, uri?, ...}], allReady, failed, elapsedMs}`. Devs DO NOT message the boss to confirm registration — the tool reports the team list synchronously, eliminating queued 'registered and ready' messages. Use for batch creation of leads/devs in multi-developer orchestration.
tool.multi_dev_spawn.model: Model ID override. If omitted, resolves from agent tier defaults.
tool.multi_dev_spawn.tier: Explicit tier (overrides agent default; ignored if model is also provided).
tool.multi_dev_register.userDescription: Self-register the current chat as a named dev in the multi-dev registry
tool.multi_dev_register.modelDescription: Called by a dev chat (in editor tab) as its FIRST action after being spawned by multi_dev_spawn. Registers the dev's chat URI under the given label. The URI is captured authoritatively from toolInvocationToken.sessionResource — must be invoked from inside the dev's chat tab.
tool.multi_dev_unregister.userDescriptio: Remove a dev entry from the multi-dev registry by label
tool.multi_dev_unregister.modelDescripti: Removes a dev from the registry by label. Can be called by the boss to evict a dev, or by a dev to remove itself. Does NOT close the chat tab — that's a manual user action. Returns error 'not_found' if the label is not registered in this workspace.
tool.multi_dev_list.userDescription: Lists all registered multi-dev chat sessions
tool.multi_dev_list.modelDescription: Returns all registered multi-dev chat entries for the current workspace, including alive status, lifecycle, and bossUri. Set includeBosses: true to also show boss entries (spawning orchestrators). By default boss entries are excluded.
tool.multi_dev_send.userDescription: Sends a message to a registered dev chat
tool.multi_dev_send.modelDescription: Sends a plain-text message to a target dev chat (by label or URI). Focuses the target tab, injects the message via workbench.action.chat.open, and returns delivery confirmation. Can reopen closed tabs. Returns a messageId that the recipient should ack via multi_dev_ack.
tool.multi_dev_ack.userDescription: Acknowledges receipt of a multi-dev message
tool.multi_dev_ack.modelDescription: Acknowledges receipt of a message by messageId (from the multidev-ack-id HTML comment trailer). Call this IMMEDIATELY when you receive a message containing <!-- multidev-ack-id: <id> -->. Returns { acked: true } on success or { acked: false, error: 'not_found' } if the messageId is unknown.
tool.multi_dev_send_and_wait_ack.userDes: Sends a message and waits for the recipient to acknowledge
tool.multi_dev_send_and_wait_ack.modelDe: Sends a plain-text message to a target dev chat and polls until the recipient calls multi_dev_ack or timeout. Returns { acked: true, latencyMs } on success, { acked: false, error: 'timeout', waitedMs } on timeout. Default timeout is 30s.
tool.multi_dev_set_status.userDescriptio: Updates this lead's status in the multi-dev registry
tool.multi_dev_set_status.modelDescripti: Updates the caller's own status in the multi-dev registry. Looks up the caller by chat URI and patches status fields (standby/busy/blocked/error + note + blockingReason + activeSessionIds). Returns { updated: true, label, status } on success, { updated: false, error: 'not_registered' } if caller is not in the registry.
tool.multi_dev_status.userDescription: Reads status of registered devs in the workspace
tool.multi_dev_status.modelDescription: Returns status information for all registered devs in the workspace (or a single one if label is provided). Each entry includes label, agent, status, statusUpdatedAt, note, blockingReason, and activeSessionIds. Does not perform liveness probing.
tool.multi_dev_broadcast.userDescription: Sends a message to multiple registered dev chats
tool.multi_dev_broadcast.modelDescriptio: Broadcasts a plain-text message to multiple registered dev chats. scope='leads' (default) sends only to entries whose agent starts with 'multidev-' or whose label ends with '-lead'. scope='all' sends to every registered dev. Entries with liveness='dead' are skipped. Each target gets its own messageId for ack tracking. Partial failures are tolerated — one target failing does not abort the broadcast. Returns per-target delivery status and a summary.
tool.multi_dev_evict.userDescription: Removes a dev from the registry with optional replacement
tool.multi_dev_evict.modelDescription: Removes a dev from the registry by label and optionally spawns a replacement in one atomic operation. Does NOT close the chat tab — that's a manual user action. If replaceWith is provided, spawns a new dev with the same label using the specified agent/instructions. Returns { evicted: true, replacedWith: {...} } on replace success, or { evicted: true, error: 'replace_failed: ...' } if spawn fails (eviction still stands). Returns { evicted: false, error: 'not_found' } if label doesn't exist.
tool.multi_dev_retire.userDescription: Marks a dev as retired (feature done) — context preserved for future revival
tool.multi_dev_retire.modelDescription: Marks a registered dev as retired (lifecycle='retired'). The dev stays in the registry with full context but is skipped by send/broadcast unless includeRetired:true is passed. Use after a feature is validated and the dev's expertise is no longer immediately needed. Reactivate via multi_dev_revive when bug-fix follow-up is required. Does NOT close the chat tab nor delete the chat session.
tool.multi_dev_revive.userDescription: Reactivates a retired dev for bug-fix follow-up
tool.multi_dev_revive.modelDescription: Reactivates a previously-retired dev (lifecycle='active' again). Use to recall a dev with feature context for bug-fix follow-ups. Returns { revived: true, label } on success or { revived: false, error: 'not_found' } if label doesn't exist.
tool.multi_dev_smoke.userDescription: Run automated smoke variants validating multi-dev tool reliability
tool.multi_dev_smoke.modelDescription: Boss-callable validation harness. Variants: spawn-burst (I1+I5), rapid-send (I3), ack-cycle (I2+I7), tier-routing (Wave B-M3), full. Set cleanup:false to leave registry artifacts for inspection.
